issue.title: docs-check lychee: bank.md Bank walk link escapes docs/
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-lk.3.1.4 note #1 during Gmail reopen docs verification. Offline lychee fails on docs/bank.md:210 because the root-level page links ../reference/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md#bank-walk, escaping docs/. The phase reproduced the failure on the clean base as well. Land audit on ff272bc6758d643caebe1fa607fd1ecc14fabb0c independently confirms the literal path and git blame: commit 643b3697, phase bob-cli-lm.5; origin epic bob-cli-lm is closed. No active epic from the full in-progress sweep owns this defect. Fix the target to reference/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md#bank-walk and verify the built link with bob-docs build/links or just docs-check. Read docs.md first. This is distinct from bob-cli-l7 (gcal-notes.md to Mac event-notes); fixing l7 will not repair bank.md. Searches across task types and the recent CI/bug sweeps found no bank-walk target duplicate. Size small: one known relative-path correction and focused docs gate. No Gmail changes are required.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The source has a deterministic ../ path escape from a docs-root page, introduced by 643b3697. Phase bob-cli-lk.3.1.4 reproduced offline lychee on its unchanged clean base; landing independently confirmed the source path and blame.
